items.title: Ray Bauduc Interview, 1984-06-27
items.q: Lefty Hyman was with the bed... we all got together... I moved in with them... Lefty Hyman was with the bed

ctx.x: Um, but anyway, uh, they finally, after, after they, after they worked out that, that deal, I think it was about 10 or 12 weeks or something like that that they were there. He, he, like, uh, liked the, the way my brother had the band, and the way he handled the band, and the way it sounded and all, and he thought that, that they should be around in New York, and, and, and do a lot of these, uh, theaters and stuff around in the New England states, you know, and so forth, but, uh, he gave a big bill up on the…
Yeah, well, I, I'll bring up a name, did you ever know Art Landry?
